verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect paths out. The Go SDK can unlock the domain at the registrar (a prerequisite for transferring away), and the XML API and Terraform provider give programmatic access to DNS records, so they could be scripted into an export. The CEO's statement about customers 'moving' domains implies transfer-out works in practice. missing for 10: a documented bulk data or account export, DNS zone file export in an open format, documented EPP/auth-code retrieval and transfer-out flow, and hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
